accepted.sentence: A child seat mounted behind the rider lets caregivers bring young passengers along on nearby trips.
In congested city centers, traveling under pedal power can bypass traffic queues and save time on short journeys.
Replacing short car trips with pedal-powered journeys can reduce fuel consumption and local tailpipe emissions.
A hitched trailer can carry children or bulky loads that would be awkward to secure on the frame.
Secure parking near transit stops lets commuters combine a ride with a bus or train journey.
A front basket keeps small purchases close at hand, making quick grocery errands easier to manage.
Because it needs no fuel, this form of transport can help households keep everyday travel costs low.
Organized charity rides bring participants together on planned routes while raising money for community causes.
